tools.name: get_youtube_transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript of a YouTube video from its link. Returns the captions YouTube has for the video (subtitles uploaded by the creator, or the auto-generated captions) as plain text, with the title, channel and the caption languages available. Does not work for videos without captions, or for privat

tools.name: transcribe_tiktok_video
tools.description: Transcribe the speech in a TikTok video to text from its link. The spoken language is detected automatically. Usually takes 20 to 60 seconds. Free use is limited per day and per video length; if the transcription is not finished when this call returns, it gives a job_id for get_transcription_result.

tools.name: get_transcription_result
tools.description: Get the result of a transcription that transcribe_tiktok_video started but did not finish in time. Pass the job_id that call returned.
